    - heading "Agentic AI for healthcare, built for the people who deliver it" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Healthcare is innately human — but repetitive, high-volume tasks are limiting time spent on the moments that matter most. Amazon Connect Health handles patient scheduling, clinical documentation, and medical coding alongside your teams, keeping providers informed and in control while delivering proven results across the care continuum.
    - button "Get started"
    - button "Request a demo"
    - heading "What is Amazon Connect Health?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Built for healthcare providers and health technology developers, Amazon Connect Health delivers agentic patient verification, appointment management, patient insights, ambient documentation, and medical coding — giving patients faster access to care, clinicians more time for care, and staff capacity for specialized work.
    - paragraph: You can deploy Amazon Connect Health in days instead of months with native EHR and Amazon Connect Customer AI integrations, and a fully managed, unified SDK. It is built with healthcare-specialized AI trained on healthcare domain expertise and data, with full traceability for every insight, note, and medical code to enable efficient review and verification.

      - text: Amazon Connect Health patient engagement capabilities are available pre-integrated into
      - link "Amazon Connect Customer":

      - text: a complete AI-powered solution for delivering personalized customer experiences at scale. Deploy within your Amazon Connect instance with real-time access to your EHR in days. Customize verification requirements and appointment capabilities based on your security standards, patient populations, and operational requirements. Patient verification (generally available)
    - paragraph: Delivers secure, conversational patient identity verification through real-time EHR access, eliminating multi-step manual record lookup for contact center staff while streamlining experiences for patients . Customizable verification attributes based on your security standards and requirements and safety guardrails ensure every interaction meet your organizational needs.
    - paragraph: Appointment management (preview)
    - paragraph: Handles scheduling via natural language voice with real-time EHR access and insurance eligibility checks — diverting appointment-related calls away from overwhelmed staff and providing patients 24/7 access to scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellations.
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - heading "Point of care" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Connect Health is available via a unified SDK for health technology developers, so you can integrate capabilities directly into your EHR, applications, or workflows in days. Provider end users can access agentic capabilities within your existing systems without workflow disruption.
    - paragraph: Patient insights (preview)
    - paragraph: Surfaces visit-specific insights including patient summaries, health events since last visit, and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) recapture from longitudinal records. Reduces the time spent piecing together the patient’s medical history before the visit.
    - paragraph: Ambient documentation (generally available)
    - paragraph: Generates clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations in real time, automatically formatting them into existing EHR templates while drafting patient-friendly after-visit summaries for clinician review — reducing workflow disruption so clinicians can focus on patient connection rather than documentation burden. Supports 22+ specialities with real-time streaming.
    - paragraph: Medical coding (gated preview)
    - paragraph: Generates ICD-10 and CPT codes from clinical notes with audit-ready source traceability and confidence scores — enabling clinicians or medical coders to validate predictions instantly, accelerating revenue cycles while reducing claim denials, reducing errors and denials. Can be used with our ambient documentation capability or other notes.
